Internationally acclaimed literary fiction like The Silent Patient , Yellowface , and The Palace of Illusions , translated Korean fiction like The Vegetarian and Hindi works like poetry of Kabir and books written by Babasaheb Ambedkar are among the most popular reading choices for Gen Z in India, according to a National Book Trust (NBT) report based on a sample survey of visitors to the New Delhi World Book Fair (NDWBF) 2026.
